hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was scrubbing the hearth, my hands steady, when I noticed her. She was perched on a chair, her eyes wide as a moth in moonlight. I couldn't help but notice the way she held the tray, her fingers brushing the edges of the candle. I wanted to know more about her, her secrets, her desires.
caption:
Caught in the moment: our new maid and her tray of secrets.
